mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA(RELA_ID, MPARTY_ID, SPARTY_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) SELECT A.RELA_ID, B.PARTY_ID,C.PARTY_ID, A.CREATE_USER, A.CREATE_TIME, A.CREATE_DEPT, A.UPDATE_USER, A.UPDATE_TIME FROM INTERF_CFETS_PARTY_RELA_TMP A, INTERF_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TMP B, INTERF_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TMP C WHERE A.MPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = B.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID(+) AND A.SPARTY_CUSTOMER_ID = C.PARTY_CUSTOMER_ID(+)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA TMP WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT MAX(RELA_ID) ID, MPARTY_ID, SPARTY_ID FROM MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_RELA GROUP BY MPARTY_ID, SPARTY_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)T WHERE TMP.MPARTY_ID = T.MPARTY_ID AND TMP.SPARTY_ID = T.SPARTY_ID AND TMP.RELA_ID != T.ID )
